name: saas-sms-calendar
description: SaaS SMS Calendar - Multi-tenant booking and appointment system

scripts.dev: npm run prekill && concurrently "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:client" --names "API,CLIENT" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd api && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.build: cd api && npm run build && cd ../client && npm run build
scripts.start: npm run prekill && concurrently "npm run start:api" "npm run start:client" --names "API,CLIENT"
scripts.lint: cd api && npm run lint && cd ../client && npm run lint
